minutes.headline: Cable committee agreed to ask the town clerk how to treat a write-in Cemetery candidate's airtime request; manager reported studio flood move.
minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee spent much of the meeting on a write-in Cemetery Commission candidate seeking airtime and threatening an OCPF complaint, and agreed to consult the town clerk and send a minimal acknowledgement. The manager reported on the flooded studio and planned move, a new videographer, ARPA equipment purchases and program counts. Prior minutes were approved, the budget was reported passed at town meeting, and setting meeting dates was tabled.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the prior meeting, after discussion correcting a typo about the Tricaster
Table agenda item 10, setting the FY meeting dates

budget_items.what_was_said: The manager returned one switcher and planned to order an HDMI switcher and other items needed after town meeting, paid from ARPA funds. A new Sony camera was raised for discussion before purchase.
Members suggested checking with the assistant town manager about insurance for the camera that got wet; batteries at end of life need replacing.
The PACC budget went through on the consent calendar with no presentation, funding it for the next 12 months.

budget_items.topic: Investment income from the Enterprise fund
budget_items.what_was_said: The committee hoped for a yearly return from its investment and has received a lesser amount through three quarters, with the fund balance reported at March 31.
The license expires in February 2028 and Mass Access is signalling no more capital funding at renewal.
A financial statement from Comcast was received from which quarterly earnings should be derivable, though earnings are not separated by video and internet services.
Two quotes exist for audio in the new room and a third vendor via the state Operational Services Division will be contacted.
The manager gave a figure for the month's report and said programs produced reached a total exceeding last year.

decisions.decision: The chair and manager will meet with the town clerk to confirm how to treat the write-in Cemetery candidate and airtime.
The chair will reply to the candidate's emails with a minimal acknowledgement that the committee will consult the town clerk.
The next show date of the 29th is kept; the studio move can be done in pieces if needed.
Next meeting set for June 3 at six o'clock in this room.
Paul will continue writing the minutes.

what_happened.line: The committee agreed to consult the town clerk on how to treat a write-in Cemetery Commission candidate's request for airtime.
The chair will send the candidate a minimal reply saying the committee is consulting the town clerk.
The manager reported on the flooded studio and planned move; the next show date is kept, with the move done in pieces if needed.
The committee's budget passed at town meeting on the consent calendar, and the Comcast license was noted as expiring in February 2028.
Setting the fiscal-year meeting dates was tabled, though the vote is not audible; the next meeting is set for June 3.

why_it_matters: How a public-access channel treats candidates asking for airtime bears on equal access to local election coverage, and the clerk's answer will set the practice.
The Comcast license ends in February 2028, and the signal that capital funding may not continue at renewal bears on how the channel pays for equipment later.
watch_next: Next meeting June 3 at six o'clock, with the clerk's guidance on the write-in candidate and the tabled meeting dates due.
The ARPA-funded equipment orders, which were planned for after town meeting.

reconciliation.coverage: official minutes are a summary only
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the tabled FY meeting dates and on the enterprise fund interest and balance, once the caption garbling is corrected. The thing to know is that the official minutes are a short summary and leave out several items we recorded: the Comcast date, the manager's figures, the show date, the next meeting and the studio move. Who took the cemetery-candidate follow-up, and who was present and left early, should be checked against the recording.
